## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION, Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Credit stress signal mixed-to-negative (HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY; LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY → HYG/LQD ↓) while cycle cues (CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND) confirm money rotating into cyclical/tech exposures.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND showing lower volatility. Mixed credit: HYG/LQD ratio down (credit stress rising) even as HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) and LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) sit in RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) is in RECOVERY, leaving the SPY/TLT ratio flat (CORRECTION). Dollar strength is elevated (index ABOVE TREND) and the Yield Curve (1W: +1.32% | 1M: -1.73%) is in RECOVERY, implying modestly tighter external conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leadership intact: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. Lone laggard is Materials: XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND — style: Growth/Momentum favored over Materials.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperformance: SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed but improving: EEM (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND while China remains weak: FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative tone present but selective: IWM (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY show appetite, while IBIT (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND signals crypto weakness.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation signal active: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND and Copper/Gold ratio ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Gold cooling: GLD (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed energy: XLE (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND but crude shows short-term softness — BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION highlight commodity price divergence.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis leadership — XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND with broad sector participation (10/11 up). DIVERGENCE: commodity proxies BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION signal price stress in energy pockets — treat as transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor Growth/Tech exposure (XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND) and selective cyclicals; reduce exposure to Materials (XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND) and China (FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND). Monitor credit signals (HYG/LQD) for regime inflection.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND — watch semis leadership. BEARISH: XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND and Materials names showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND if reflation extends. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION — watch for further downside risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency signal) — VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD ratio 0.80 (credit health watch) — HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY; LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY. XLK/XLF tech vs finance pivot level ~3.47 (Tech vs Financials 1W: +3.06% | 1M: +11.46%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, driven by tech/semis strength alongside mixed credit signals. XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk is credit/commodity divergence — monitor HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY; LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY) and energy corrections (BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION).
